import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from scripts.monitor_lpx_gpu_study import save
from scripts.run_lpx_gpu_study import read_json
root = Path.cwd()
status_path = root / "experiments/lpx/gpu-cc302-native-analysis-status.json"
state = dict(status="waiting-for-native", pid=os.getpid(), started_unix=time.time())
save(status_path, state)
try:
    while True:
        worker = read_json(root / "experiments/lpx/gpu-cc302-collection-status.json")
        if {"plain", "ngram-k7"} <= set(worker.get("completed", [])):
            break
        if worker["status"] == "failed" or not Path(f"/proc/{worker['pid']}").exists():
            raise RuntimeError("Native collector stopped before validation completed")
        time.sleep(10)
    state.update(status="running", analysis_started_unix=time.time())
    save(status_path, state)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-u", "scripts/analyze_lpx_gpu_cc302.py", "--work-dir", "/tmp/lpx-gpu", "--requests", "/tmp/lpx-gpu/inputs/requests-cc302.jsonl", "--phase", "native"], check=True)
    state.update(status="complete", finished_unix=time.time())
except Exception as error:
    state.update(status="failed", error=str(error), finished_unix=time.time())
    raise
finally:
    save(status_path, state)
purpose: Wait for both validated collections, then run the CPU-only C3 native analysis without taking the GPU lock.
